faqs.question: What is your typical response time?
faqs.answer: I usually respond to all inquiries within 24 hours on business days. For urgent matters, please mention it in your message.

faqs.question: Do you work on freelance projects?
faqs.answer: Yes! I'm open to freelance opportunities, especially interesting projects involving AI, full stack development or DevOps.

faqs.question: What are your hourly rates?
faqs.answer: My rates depend on the project scope and complexity. Share your requirements and I'll send a detailed quote.

faqs.question: Can you help with existing projects?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! I can help with code reviews, bug fixes, performance optimization or adding new features to existing projects.
